title: Refund policy / 退款政策
text:
# Refund policy / 退款政策

Customers may request refunds within 30 days of purchase. Provide the original order ID, payment receipt and refund reason. Consumed credits cannot be refunded. 退款期限为购买后30天，需订单号、支付凭证和退款原因，已消耗额度不可退款。

title: Duplicate charge / 重复扣款
text:
# Duplicate charge / 重复扣款

For duplicate charges, collect both transaction IDs and the invoice number. Billing investigates matching payment records before any adjustment. Do not issue an automatic refund. 重复扣款需两笔交易ID及发票号，由账务核对支付记录后调整，不可自动退款。

title: Email change / 邮箱变更
text:
# Email change / 邮箱变更

Changing a login email requires verification of both the current email and the target email. Support must confirm account ownership before updating the login address. 登录邮箱变更需验证当前和目标邮箱，并先确认账户归属。

title: Account recovery / 账户恢复
text:
# Account recovery / 账户恢复

A locked account requires identity verification through the recovery form. Never ask for passwords or one-time codes. Escalate suspicious access to the security team. 锁定账户通过恢复表单验证身份，不得索要密码或一次性验证码，可疑访问升级安全团队。

title: Project export / 项目导出
text:
# Project export / 项目导出

Project members can export CSV from the project page. Exports include records from the selected date range. XLSX and PDF exports are not supported. 项目成员可在项目页面导出所选日期范围的CSV，暂不支持XLSX和PDF导出。

title: API incident / 接口故障
text:
# API incident / 接口故障

For API failures, collect endpoint, request ID, error message and reproduction steps. A complete service outage or data loss requires urgent escalation. 接口故障收集接口地址、请求ID、错误信息和复现步骤，服务完全不可用或数据丢失需紧急升级。

title: Subscription cancellation / 订阅取消
text:
# Subscription cancellation / 订阅取消

Cancel subscriptions from billing settings. Cancellation stops renewal at the end of the paid period and does not immediately revoke access. 订阅在账务设置取消，已付费周期结束后停止续订，当前访问权限不会立即撤销。

title: Data retention / 数据保留
text:
# Data retention / 数据保留

Deleted projects remain recoverable for 14 days. After the retention period they are permanently removed. Restoration requires a project administrator. 删除项目可在14天内恢复，之后永久删除，恢复需项目管理员权限。
